description: A chat's draft written (a change to the chat: Agent Management's write), kept by its host as the newest whatever was there (the last write wins), and told every other head attached to it (draft_changed). Sent a moment after typing stops, as the chat's left, and at once as the box is emptied by sending (sent). One written before the draft's last send is refused (stale_draft), its draft as kept now with it.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

text.description: What's written in its box now (empty: nothing, as once it's sent).

epoch.description: The draft's epoch its text was written in (ChatDraft's epoch, as this head last had it): one less than its host's now (a send's emptied it since), and it's refused (stale_draft), so what was sent isn't written back.

sent.description: A send's id, of the head's own pick (one each Enter): the box emptied by sending what was in it. The draft emptied, and its epoch one more.

head.description: The box writing it, an id of the head's own pick (one each window or chat page): carried in the draft as it's told, so the box knows its own save.
